gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The ___ (APPLY) for the visa took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'The application' = the act or form of applying; 'applicant' = the person.

gaps.sentence: His sudden ___ (RESIGN) surprised everyone in the department.
gaps.hint: noun: act of leaving a job

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.
